_README: Deployment policy file for the certification job in CI -- not an example of
what a deployment should declare. Checks C04-C06 need a plan that a policy
MODIFIES; a clean hub has none. This excludes one sensor that the job
registers for the purpose (ci-policy-probe) from report_status, which the
suite fires, leaving the certification's own test device untouched.
